description: Independent container capture. One synthetic dummy-input log record via Forward output with gzip and Require_ack_response On. fluent_signal=0, timestamp metadata array with empty metadata map. No credentials or real log content.
configuration:
[SERVICE]
    Flush 1
[INPUT]
    Name dummy
    Tag interop.collector.fluentbit
    Dummy {"message":"reference-fluentbit-gzip","fixture":"fluentbit"}
    Rate 1
[OUTPUT]
    Name forward
    Match *
    Host host.docker.internal
    Port 25425
    Require_ack_response On
    Compress gzip
